offers.description: Free, capacity-limited beta invitations; no paid plan is currently active.

mainEntity.name: What is OneCommit and who is it for?

acceptedAnswer.text: OneCommit is a self-service recruiting workspace for high school Track & Field and Cross Country athletes. It helps athletes compare schools, prepare personal outreach, and track coach replies from their own inbox.

mainEntity.name: How does the school matching work?

acceptedAnswer.text: OneScore compares your times or marks, academics, and college preferences with the current D3 beta dataset. It is school-fit guidance, not a guarantee of coach interest or admission.

Riley is OneCommit’s AI recruiting coach — a feature in the app, not a person. Riley guides the voice onboarding that captures marks, academics, and college preferences, and athletes review the resulting profile details before moving on.

mainEntity.name: Do the emails come from my own inbox?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. When you connect Outlook/Microsoft 365, the inbox provider currently offered in the beta app, emails go out from your real email address, so coaches see a genuine person reaching out — not a third-party platform.

mainEntity.name: Do I have to send the generated email as-is?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. OneCommit gives you a first draft based on your profile. You can edit it before sending, and the final email goes from your own inbox.

mainEntity.name: Can I use OneCommit if I’m already talking to coaches?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Add schools you are already contacting to your dashboard and use OneCommit to organize recruiting messages, replies, and additional outreach.

mainEntity.name: What if a school I want isn’t in the database?

acceptedAnswer.text: Search by school name or use SmartAdd to describe what you are looking for. Schools outside the current D3 beta dataset may have limited matching detail, so review the available information before adding them to your plan.

mainEntity.name: How many schools should I reach out to?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no single number for every athlete. Build a balanced list, review each school, and send only messages you are prepared to personalize and follow up on.

mainEntity.name: Is my data private? Who sees my profile?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your profile is not a public recruiting page. OneCommit doesn’t sell or rent your data, and coaches only hear from you if you choose to send them an email. We use the service providers listed in our Privacy Policy to operate the product.
Right now, OneCommit supports Track & Field, including Cross Country. We are focused on getting this workflow right before expanding to other sports.

Outlook/Microsoft 365 is currently the only inbox option offered in the beta app. Gmail is not currently available. Provider availability can change during beta; contact support before planning outreach if Outlook/Microsoft 365 does not work for you.

Invited core app access is free during the beta; availability depends on beta capacity and a supported app-access path. No paid plan, advisor subscription, or recurring call package is active today. Any future price and terms will be shown before billing can start.

mainEntity.name: How is this different from NCSA or CaptainU?

acceptedAnswer.text: Traditional services center on a public profile and passive discovery, and the largest of them does not publish a price at all — it asks you to book a call to find out. OneCommit is built around the athlete taking action: building a school list, sending outreach from their own email, and tracking replies in one workspace. We will show our price before anyone is asked to pay.

mainEntity.name: I have a question or need help. How do I get support?

acceptedAnswer.text: Email us at admin@onecommit.us. You can also use the in-app help section.
